audit: V1-A-R Area B: Impeccable Overlap Reconciliation

integratedRules.name: Accessible Color Contrast Ratios
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Enforce minimum contrast: 4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text, 3:1 non-text UI graphics
integratedRules.notes: Calibrated to WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 (Level AA) and SC 1.4.11 (Level AA).

integratedRules.name: Restricted Accent Palette
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Limit accent colors to maximum two semantic hues to avoid visual noise
integratedRules.notes: Prevents color clutter across multi-pane agent dashboards.

integratedRules.name: Font Family Pairing Discipline
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Limit typography to at most two typefaces (body + monospace for code)

integratedRules.name: Optimal Reading Line Length
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Enforce measure between 45 and 75 characters per line for body prose
integratedRules.notes: Improves reading comfort in documentation and log projections.

integratedRules.name: Interactive Target Minimum Sizing
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Enforce 44x44 CSS px target sizing under Gravitas Policy (WCAG AA floor is 24x24px)
integratedRules.notes: Gravitas Policy standard claim calibrated: NOT_WCAG_AA_MINIMUM.

integratedRules.name: Interactive Target Insets & Spacing
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Enforce minimum 8px physical spacing between interactive touch/click targets
integratedRules.notes: Prevents accidental trigger of adjacent controls.

integratedRules.name: Respect Prefers-Reduced-Motion
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Wrap all transitions in prefers-reduced-motion media query and provide instant state changes
integratedRules.notes: Essential accessibility requirement for motion sensitivity.

integratedRules.name: Bounded Animation Duration
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Limit UI transition durations between 150ms and 300ms
integratedRules.notes: Guarantees UI feels responsive and eliminates sluggish animations.

integratedRules.name: Centralized 4/8pt Spacing Grid
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Align all padding, margins, and component dimensions to multiples of 4px or 8px
integratedRules.notes: Establishes rhythmic visual harmony across surfaces.

integratedRules.name: Whitespace & Spatial Hierarchy
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Ensure space between unrelated sections is strictly greater than space within sections

integratedRules.name: Design Token Centralization
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Define all colors, spacing, and font sizes as centralized CSS custom properties
integratedRules.notes: Avoids magic numbers and hardcoded colors in CSS.

integratedRules.name: Preserve Visible Focus Indicators
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Never remove outline: none without providing an accessible :focus-visible replacement
integratedRules.notes: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.7 Level AA compliance requirement.

integratedRules.name: Accessible Semantic Status Badges
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Pair status colors with text labels or symbols; never convey status solely through color
integratedRules.notes: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 Level A compliance requirement.

integratedRules.name: Anti-AI-Slop Layout Hygiene
integratedRules.normalizedGravitasRule: Avoid gratuitous purple gradients, meaningless floating blur blobs, and repetitive cards
integratedRules.notes: Aligns with Ponytail minimalist brutalist engineering principles.
